basis.saw: the ORCID iD mark — a green roundel with a white lowercase `iD`, placed against the author's name in the byline. Geometry called it `figure` at coverage 0.00015, which is the role-from-area failure this schema separates `inspection` from `geometry` to catch.

narrative.text: The ORCID iD mark: a green roundel carrying a white lowercase `iD`, set immediately after the author's name in the byline. It is publisher furniture rather than content of the paper — it carries no argument, datum or figure — and in the source PDF it is the only embedded raster on any of the six pages.
